outcome: Expression levels of advanced glycation end products (AGEs)
cohort: 72 pregnant women with GDM and 80 normal pregnant women
finding: The expression levels of AGEs, visfatin, and IL-6 in placental tissues were positively correlated with MDA in GDM pregnant women, while APN was negatively correlated with MDA.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean section was significantly higher in the GDM group compared to the control group.
